Read the Ode to eternity book Arianwyn gave you before placing any items. Then solve the pillar puzzle: inspect the pillars to get their hints. Each hint ends in 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th or 6th. Go by the words of each hint, not by the pillar you read it on: most hints give the item for a different pillar. You can skip the hint that says it is not opposite a number, as that item is the one left over. Placing an item on the wrong pillar fails the puzzle, so you must get the items again and the numbers change.

The ending of a hint names the item: 1st is the nature rune, 2nd the irit leaf or a flower, 3rd the black knife or black dagger, 4th the wine of Zamorak or Zamorak brew, 5th the adamant chainbody and 6th the cabbage.

Place each item by the wording of its hint: "I am the" goes on the south west pillar, "I am next to the" on the west pillar, "I am opposite the" on the north west pillar, "I am not next to the" on the east pillar and "I am not the" on the north east pillar. The item left over goes on the south east pillar.

Dig south-east of Port Tyras, near a yew tree, 4 squares south of a group of three mushrooms. A charter ship to Port Tyras is the quick way: go through the camp, north through the dense forest, east and south through the next dense forest, then over a tripwire and south to the spot. If digging finds nothing, ask the Observatory professor about treasure trails for a sextant, watch and chart, destroy the clue, and get a new one from Baxtorian.

Dig in Zul-Andra, on the east side of the northernmost hut, two squares north of the small hole in the ground (or the STASH unit, if you've built it). A Zul-andra teleport takes you there. You can also use fairy ring BJS and the stepping stones (76 Agility), or charter a ship to Port Tyras and head south, then south-east.
Dig outside Prifddinas's south gate, one square north of the north-eastern elven lamp. The Iorwerth camp teleport is quickest: go east through the dense forests, then north to the gate.

Make sure you're prepared for battle. Enter the Underground Pass from the Elven Lands entrance, then enter the Well of Voyage. Leave the well area through the door and follow the winding path south. Enter the south cave to go down to the lower level, then go to the dwarven camp.

st.t: Fill the 7 holes around the camp's entrance. You can get more explosive potions from Elena.

Defend the camp for four minutes. You don't have to kill every elf: attack any that are hitting the barricade to draw them onto you.
Defeat Essyllt. Protect from melee. He can drain your stats, so drink super restores when needed. When he shoves you, flick to Protect from Ranged then back to Protect from Melee.
After Essyllt, a cutscene starts the Fragment of Seren fight straight away. Only magic can hurt her. If you aren't in magic gear, teleport out, bank and gear up.

If you left, go back the way you reached the dwarven camp: enter the Underground Pass from the Elven Lands entrance, then enter the Well of Voyage. Leave the well area through the door and follow the winding path south. Enter the south cave and the fight starts again.

Defeat the Fragment of Seren. Protect from Ranged, and keep your distance. She is only susceptible to magic damage, so bring your best magic gear. If she moves you close to her and locks you in place, she is about to hit 99% of your max health. Eat up. If she spawns a healing spell, attack it to destroy it. If she splits into multiple fragments, attack the light coloured one.
Talk to Baxtorian outside of Prifddinas to finish the quest, and unlock Prifddinas!
